question: A cyclotron accelerates deuterons ($q=e, m=2m_p$) to a maximum energy of 10 MeV using a magnetic field $B$ and Dee radius $R$. If the same cyclotron (same $B$ and $R$) is used to accelerate protons ($q=e, m=m_p$), with the oscillator frequency adjusted appropriately for resonance in each case, what will be the maximum energy of the protons?
